fabricationFlags: Scholarships fabricated: 'Goldsmiths International Scholarship' (GBP 4,000), 'Arts Excellence Award' (GBP 3,000) and 'Postgraduate Masters Scholarship' (GBP 2,500) do not appear anywhere on the official Goldsmiths scholarships finder, international fees-funding page, or scholarships index. Official site only enumerates external awards (Chevening, Marshall, etc.) and a non-itemized scholarships finder tool.

Tuition figures understated/invented: JSON BMus Music GBP 18,000 vs official GBP 23,000 (2026/27); JSON MSc Data Science GBP 20,000 vs official GBP 22,000. Figures do not match any current official band.

All programUrl values for core degrees return HTTP 404 (e.g. /undergraduate/programmes/music/ -> real path is /ug/bmus-music/; /postgraduate/programmes/data-science/ -> real path is /pg/msc-data-science-artificial-intelligence/). URLs appear synthesized rather than copied from the live site.

7 of 11 'programs' entries are not academic programmes at all: a careers 'Career options with a PhD' page, 'PhD/Postgraduate Research careers', a student profile ('Erica, BSc Psychology'), another student profile ('Ting Hsuan, BA Drama and Theatre Arts'), a 'PhD (doctoral) theses' library page, and a 'PhD Research in CISP' page. These are mislabeled as degree programmes with durationYears/level/intakes and marked verified:true, indicating scraped/padded filler.
MSc title mismatch: JSON 'MSc Data Science' but official programme is 'MSc Data Science and Artificial Intelligence'.
BMus title mismatch: JSON 'BMus Music' but official title is 'BMus (Hons) Music'.
